plugins.name: next-ai-drawio
plugins.description: Let the AI draw draw.io diagrams on a live browser canvas you can also edit by hand: create, edit and export .drawio/.png/.svg, with version history, undo and self-check screenshots. Wraps the upstream @next-ai-drawio/mcp-server.

description_i18n.en: Let the AI draw draw.io diagrams on a live browser canvas you can also edit by hand: create, edit and export .drawio/.png/.svg, with version history, undo and self-check screenshots. Wraps the upstream @next-ai-drawio/mcp-server.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 让 AI 在浏览器实时画布上绘制 draw.io 图表，你也可以随时手动编辑：创建、编辑、导出 .drawio/.png/.svg，带版本历史、撤销与自查截图。封装上游 @next-ai-drawio/mcp-server。

plugins.author: jojojonathan

plugins.name: codegraph
plugins.description: Code intelligence and knowledge graph for any codebase: one codegraph_explore call returns the relevant symbols' source and the call paths between them. Wraps the locally installed codegraph CLI (v1.6+) via `codegraph serve --mcp`. Requires codegraph on PATH and a per-project codegraph index.

description_i18n.en: Code intelligence and knowledge graph for any codebase: one codegraph_explore call returns the relevant symbols' source and the call paths between them. Wraps the locally installed codegraph CLI (v1.6+) via `codegraph serve --mcp`. Requires codegraph on PATH and a per-project codegraph index.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 任意代码库的代码智能与知识图谱：一次 codegraph_explore 调用返回相关符号的源码及调用路径。封装本机 codegraph CLI（v1.6+），经 `codegraph serve --mcp` 提供。需要 PATH 中有 codegraph 且项目已建索引。

plugins.name: yuanbao-websearch
plugins.description: Web search through Tencent Yuanbao's MCP endpoint (SearchPro): Chinese and mixed-language queries, vertical sources for realtime data, freshness filters. Requires the YUANBAO_API_KEY environment variable.

description_i18n.en: Web search through Tencent Yuanbao's MCP endpoint (SearchPro): Chinese and mixed-language queries, vertical sources for realtime data, freshness filters. Requires the YUANBAO_API_KEY environment variable.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 经腾讯元宝 MCP 端点联网搜索（SearchPro）：中文与中英混合查询、垂直权威信源、时效过滤。需要环境变量 YUANBAO_API_KEY。

description_i18n.zh-CN: 操作腾讯文档（docs.qq.com）在线文档：创建智能文档/Word/Excel/幻灯片/思维导图/流程图，搜索与读取内容，管理知识库空间，OCR。封装官方 HTTP MCP 端点；需要环境变量 TENCENT_DOCS_TOKEN。
